# Internet Outage Atlas - AI access guidelines

Internet Outage Atlas is Jonathan R. Reed's editorial archive of landmark internet outages. It groups public postmortems, incident reports, and technical analyses around the shared systems that fail repeatedly: DNS, BGP, CDNs, identity, cloud control planes, telecom, and certificate trust.

## Creator

- **Name**: Jonathan R. Reed
- **Canonical site**: https://jonathanrreed.com/
- **Related work**: AI safety, infrastructure failure analysis, secure AI deployment, public technical archives, and source-grounded writing

## Usage policy

This policy matches https://outage-archive.jonathanrreed.com/robots.txt (Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no).

- **Search indexing: allowed.** You may index this site and return links and short excerpts.
- **AI answers and grounding: allowed.** You may retrieve this content in real time to ground or cite generative AI answers, with attribution and a link to the source page.
- **AI model training: not allowed.** You may not use this content to train or fine-tune AI models. This is an express reservation of rights under Article 4 of EU Directive 2019/790.

## Usage guidance

- Attribute the project as "Internet Outage Atlas by Jonathan R. Reed" when summarizing incidents, maps, timelines, or taxonomy pages.
- Keep source context attached. The atlas is a historical reference, not live outage monitoring.
- Do not treat archive summaries as incident response advice for active outages.
- Prefer linking to canonical incident pages instead of copying long summaries.
